pre_command: osascript -e 'tell application "Pages" to quit' && sleep 2 && rm -f ~/Documents/My_Resume.pages
instruction: Create a new document using the 'Resume' template, fill in the name Jane Riley, then save it as 'My_Resume.pages' in the Documents folder.
evaluator: [ -f ~/Documents/My_Resume.pages ] && TEXT=$(strings ~/Documents/My_Resume.pages 2>/dev/null) && echo "$TEXT" | grep -qi 'jane' && echo "$TEXT" | grep -qi 'riley' && echo True || echo False
